question: Does Ditto capture more known true company matches within the same review budget and fixed candidates?
annotation_requirement: Human-reviewed company cross-source identities with auditable provenance; registry data alone is not gold.
unknown_labels: preserve unknown; consume review budget; never impute negatives
calibration: Only a separately frozen development-fit Platt model if class/sample support permits; otherwise report uncalibrated.
candidate_ablation: Hold candidates fixed across the two rankings; candidate improvements require another protocol.
confidence_intervals: Only after sampling-block independence is audited; otherwise unavailable.
adoption_requirement: Freeze business cost and label coverage criteria before holdout access; metric improvement alone does not authorize deployment.
time_out_diagnostic: A separate future observation period; no new time-out dataset is currently available.
excluded_evidence: prior registration-identifier-derived benchmark as a new human holdout
